scope: No-score local validation and source-owned checks; no general scoring service was added.

naturalNoScore.test: runOptimizationValidationLifecycle > discovers a source-owned deterministic check when an ordinary run has no criteria
naturalNoScore.details: An evidence record with criteria undefined was checked against the original source skill's .skvm-validation.json in an isolated validation root. The source-derived JSON-schema assertion passed for the correct output and rejected the wrong field type.

taskAssertions.test: runOptimizationValidationLifecycle > executes current task assertions instead of accepting exit zero, a same-name wrong file, or printed ok
taskAssertions.details: Contained file-check assertions are re-read from the bound task source and executed against the candidate; empty, wrong-file and stdout-only programs fail even when the process exits zero.

partialScope.test: runOptimizationValidationLifecycle > runs ready cases and independent actions while preserving a missing case as unassessed
partialScope.details: Ready cases execute, missing inputs remain action-local unresolved/unassessed, and independent actions are retained rather than being promoted by a partial result.

sourceIsolation.test: source-owned checks use sourceSkillDir while candidate files run from skillDir
sourceIsolation.details: The candidate cannot create or rewrite the source validation manifest to become its own authority; source-derived assertions retain their sourceRef and authority label.

handoff.test: captured optimization handoff local-check and recovery regressions
handoff.details: Natural handoff materializes only declared local checks, keeps evaluation separate from optimization, and resumes without replaying an external model call.

authorityBoundary.taskRequirement: Re-read contained file-check criteria from the bound task source; prior pass labels alone are not executable assertions.
authorityBoundary.sourceDerived: Read only the original source skill's validated .skvm-validation.json, require a contained sourceRef and supported file-check mode, and execute it in the isolated candidate validation root.
authorityBoundary.selfCheck: Remain separately labeled and cannot alone promote an action to an independent passed recommendation.
authorityBoundary.fidelityReference: Observed output bytes remain references unless a current task/source authority also passes.
authorityBoundary.modelEvaluation: Not invoked by this C6 deterministic verification. Missing criteria limits the corresponding recommendation rather than erasing other runnable local checks.

claimBoundary: Development evidence only. C6 demonstrates bounded source/task local checks without a user-provided score file or a universal scoring service. It does not prove complete skill correctness, translation quality, professional judgment, real model behavior, natural package consumption, effect improvement, prospective readiness, held-out performance or human savings.
